metadata.title: High-Contrast Monochromatic Portrait with Vertical Sidebar

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with dark hair, wearing a black garment, positioned against a light background. The composition features a distinct white vertical sidebar on the left containing vertically stacked, magenta-colored typography separated from the image by a thin black rule.
coreVisualRelationships: The stark black of the subject's clothing anchors the lower two-thirds of the frame.
The vertical magenta text creates a vibrant color contrast against the monochromatic image.
The thin black vertical line acts as a structural divider between the text gutter and the photographic subject.
Soft directional lighting on the face creates a focal point amidst the heavy black shadows.
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white photography for the subject.
A clean white vertical margin on the left edge.
Vertical orientation for all display text.
A single accent color for typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered-right, filling approximately 80% of the height, with one arm raised behind the head creating a triangular silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, serves as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright magenta text on the left, follows the vertical line down, then moves right into the subject's face and follows the curve of the raised arm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space is reserved in the left margin and the upper right background area.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (subject clothing and shadows) and White (background and sidebar).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high saturation reserved exclusively for the text.

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines.
Vertical stress in the bowls of the letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard high-contrast serif glyphs used.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all elements to maintain minimalist graphic impact.
graphicDevices: Thin vertical black line (1pt to 2pt) separating the text margin from the image.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant serif aesthetic of the 90s fashion era.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs for a display role.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with dark hair, wearing a black blazer, one arm raised behind her head. The background should be a light grey gradient. Leave a wide white vertical strip on the far left of the frame, separated from the photo by a thin black vertical line.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical uppercase text in the white left margin. Use a high-contrast Didone serif font in a bright magenta color. Stack the letters vertically with generous spacing between each character.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the text stacked vertically in the left margin?
Is there a thin black line separating the text from the photo?
Is the text color a vibrant magenta?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the vertical divider line
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'STACY EARL'.
Do not replicate the specific facial features of the woman in the photo.

mustAchieve: Sharp photographic focus on the face
Deep, rich blacks in the clothing

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is perfectly vertical and centered in the white margin.
Ensure the magenta color does not bleed into the black and white image.
Verify the high-contrast lighting doesn't blow out facial details.
Confirm the vertical line is perfectly straight and consistent in width.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast B&W fashion portrait with a white sidebar, a thin black divider, and vertically stacked Didone typography in a single neon accent color.
